name: Strange Pylons
summary: In Shen'dralas, a depleted crystal pylon leaves its purpose unknown. You are asked to look for others nearby.

sections.title: Among the Ruins
sections.body: A strange crystal rests on an ancient pedestal among Shen'dralas's elven ruins. Mere moments ago, emaciated mana elementals guarded it. The gemstone is fractured and its magic is nearly spent, leaving its purpose a mystery. You search the area for other pylons like it.

faq.answer: It is a fractured gemstone set on an ancient pedestal in Shen'dralas. Its depleted magic leaves its purpose unknown.
A weak hum of power comes from the fractured gemstone, though its magic is heavily depleted.
Emaciated mana elementals guarded the crystal mere moments ago.
You are asked to search Shen'dralas for other pylons like the one you found.
